resources.string: Raise this factory navigation level to make CarPlay guidance louder at 100%. It also changes the factory navigation voice volume. Maximum 11; applies immediately.
Auto tries the Android voice stream when its volume is above zero; otherwise it uses media. Select either stream to compare call sound. Reconnect CarPlay to apply.
Factory phone level, 0–15. This may not control CarPlay calls; compare while on a call. Changes apply immediately and also affect factory phone audio.
Slide to adjust each CarPlay sound immediately relative to the car volume. When a slider is focused, the volume keys adjust it in 5% steps. In car Bluetooth mode, the car controls sound instead.

On: play sound through CarPlay. Off: NiPlay sends video only; choose the car Bluetooth audio output on iPhone. CarPlay calls, Siri and navigation voice will also stop using CarPlay audio. Reconnect CarPlay for the change to take effect.

Car Bluetooth: keep Bluetooth on and select the car audio output on iPhone; NiPlay receives video only. CarPlay: receive audio in NiPlay and turn off car Bluetooth after Wi-Fi handoff, the first video frame, and an audio stream are ready. Reconnect CarPlay to apply.
Tap to open Nissan Bluetooth settings; hold to enter a car Bluetooth MAC manually.
